title: ICON 1.5 — Class: Stalwart
description: Vigilance, Rush and Heroics: what the sheet tracks for a Stalwart and what you do by hand.

steps.title: Playing a Stalwart
steps.content: Stalwarts hold the line: Armor 2, Rampart on the spaces next to them and Vigilance to punish foes that move around them (p.116). This tour opens the sheet of a Stalwart you own and shows the class tools.

steps.title: Vigilance
steps.content: Your Vigilance charges, up to 6 (p.117). Click a pip to set how many you have. Fortify gives you +1 at the end of each of your turns: add it yourself, the sheet doesn't do it for you. Abilities that say "gain vigilance" add it from their card. All charges are lost at the end of combat; the sheet empties them by itself.

steps.title: Spending Vigilance
steps.content: Spend opens a window: choose how many charges and what for. Reduce: an ally in range 2 is damaged by a foe's ability, and the damage goes down as if with armor. Punish: a foe breaks adjacency with you and takes the damage. You roll 1d6 per charge and keep the highest (the dice don't add up); the charges are taken off and the result goes to chat. A gamble can also spend Vigilance from its own window.

steps.title: The same controls on Fortify
steps.content: The class trait that gives Vigilance has the same pips and Spend button in its header, so you can use them while reading the rule.

steps.title: Rush and Heroics
steps.content: Rush X: move X spaces, unstoppable and immune to all damage during that move. Heroics: each job has its own way of performing one, and abilities with a Heroic effect gain it when you do (p.116). Neither has a counter: you decide when you performed a heroic. The ability panel shows the Heroic part, and the statuses it gives get their buttons on the card. This box opens the class rules.

steps.title: That's the Stalwart
steps.content: The other tours explain what every class shares: the ability panel and power dice (Character Sheet), damage cards (Combat), shoves and terrain (On the Map).
